messages:
Priya: Heads-up team 1 1 Launch Day cadence draft: LinkedIn post 08:30 PT, X main thread 09:30 PT, follow-up micro-replies at +8m / +18m / +35m. Need final hero image, 1:1 social crop, UTMs, and three short engagement replies per copy variant.
Jon M: I can push the hero still and a 9s teaser MP4. Will export 1:1 + 16:9. Put them in `s3://redwood-marketing/launch/1720054321/`.
Ana: I'll prep copy variants: Variant 1 = benchmark-led (latency + cost wins), Variant 2 = product-led (integration + SDK examples). Will do short LinkedIn + two X-length versions.
Zoe: Scheduling: I prefer LinkedIn earlier for reach. I'll queue LI at 08:30 PT to company page and personal Pulse. X main at 09:30 PT, then replies scheduled. Buffer/DirectPublish credentials are ready.
AutoSchedBot: Scheduling window reserved: Tue 08:00-11:00 PT. Conflict check: no overlapping enterprise posts detected.
Priya: Webinar CTA text: "Get early access" and separate pinned reply CTA: "Save your seat: /webinar?utm_source=social&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch1720". Ensure HubSpot form mapping to list `launch-2024-social` and webhook to `#leads-launch`.
Jon M: Uploaded assets: `hero_16x9_v3.png`, `hero_1x1_v2.png`, `teaser_9s_v1.mp4`. Links in folder + small README.
Ana: Draft micro-replies for VAR A (benchmark):
- A1: "Which model size did you run that on?"
- A2: "Nice numbers 1 can we share the test config?"
- A3: "Want a short walk-through of the benchmark setup?"
Draft micro-replies for VAR B (product):
- B1: "How long to integrate with our stack?"
- B2: "Any examples for routing traffic across regions?"
- B3: "Where can I try the hosted flow?"
Priya: Tone tweak: shorten for X (drop articles), add emoji sparingly. Keep the webinar CTA in the 1st reply as pinned on X.
Zoe: Queueing details: LinkedIn company + Pulse 08:30 PT, personal shares at 09:00 PT. X thread main at 09:30 PT with pinned reply queued. Replies set at +8m, +18m, +35m. UTM params appended to all links.
OpsBot: Landing page status: live, pixel installed, HubSpot form `hs_form_1720` -> list `launch-2024-social`. Retargeting audience seeded with existing webinar visitors.
Priya: Quick ask: Can we run A/B on the top line of the copy? If yes, we'll post variant A to a control cohort (10% audience) and B to rest. Zoe, can Buffer handle that split?
Zoe: Buffer can't do audience splits. We can use X native scheduling + manual split by posting variant A from the company handle and variant B from a brand partner handle, or use paid seeding later. Recommend manual split to keep organic metrics clean.
Jon M: Confirming final file names and sizes in the README. Also adding an optimized GIF fallback for low-bandwidth devices.
Ana: I'll compress X copy to X-appropriate length and add hashtags: #llm #inference #redwood. LinkedIn copy will be slightly longer with a short bullet on benefits.
Priya: Good. Final approvals: I need final copy + pinned reply by 4:30pm PT today. If no objections, I'll hit publish on Tue. :thumbsup:
Zoe: I've set the schedule to "hold" until Priya approves. I'll enable webhook to `#leads-launch` so SDRs get instant notifications.
Priya: One more routing detail: tag incoming leads with `source:social_launch_1720` and `origin:linkedin/x-thread` for segmentation. OpsBot, confirm tag creation?
OpsBot: Tag rules added to HubSpot: `social_launch_1720`. Webhook mapping to Slack `#leads-launch` confirmed.
Ana: Final micro-replies will include an invite CTA in one of the replies and a short demo offer in another. I'll post the final variants here by 4pm.
Jon M: All assets ready and verified.
Priya: Thanks 1 if all good, I'll sign off at 5pm and Zoe, you can release queues.
Zoe: Roger. Will release after sign-off and monitor engagement for 60 minutes to adjust retargeting.
Priya: Excellent 1 let's aim for high CTRs and a clean lead flow.
